input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding Bluefly. Section 14.16 (Freedom of Action) is mutual and expressly preserves each party's freedom to contract with others, and searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "shall not" and develop/engage-in language turned up only warranty disclaimers, licence-scope terms and jurisdiction boilerplate. The only Customer-side restrictions are §14.11 (no resale of the Services) and §12.1 (licence to use Base Components solely in connection with the Services, no reverse engineering), which are ordinary scope-of-use/licence limits rather than restrictions on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build; §14.19 limits IBM's delivery territory, not our activities. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
